description: This file defines the 'Permission' entity class used in the application's security model. It includes properties for permission name, associated groups, and audit information, with JPA and Hibernate annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Entity class representing a security permission, including name, associated groups, and audit details.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the permission.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the permission.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns audit information for the permission.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets audit information for the permission.

methods.name: getPermissionName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the permission.

methods.name: setPermissionName
methods.description: Sets the name of the permission.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of groups associated with this permission.

methods.name: setGroups
methods.description: Sets the list of groups associated with this permission.
